description: R92 dependency policy (skill r92-dependencies; plan PLAN-r92-architecture-migration 0.9, R92-10): latest stable at least 3 days old, security fixes at once, exact pins, images by digest, Actions by SHA. Renovate PRs are ordinary changes (skill r92-assurance): never automerged. Security fixes take the newest safe release (vulnerabilityFixStrategy highest), with no release age.

packageRules.description: Theme tarballs are bumped by theme releases (skill r92-theme), never by Renovate.
Node: Active and Maintenance LTS only (node versioning treats non-LTS majors as unstable).
engines, peerDependencies and requires-python state what consumers may use: keep their ranges (an exact peer stays exact), never pin them.

Container tags: Docker Hub returns no timestamp for many tags of large repositories (node, golang), so a required timestamp would hold those updates back forever; unstamped tags are not age-gated and the reviewer checks the upstream release date.
Minor and patch grouped per ecosystem: npm.

**Scan.** Renovate checked the versions in use against OSV.dev (`osvVulnerabilityAlerts`); it does not scan the target. Before merging, the target and what it pulls in must show no Critical or High: this repo's verify step (`npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`, `govulncheck ./...`, `uv export | check-package.sh pypi -`, Trivy for images) or `/usr/share/agent-skills/r92-dependencies/scripts/check-package.sh <ecosystem> <name> <version>`. The reviewer records the result in a PR comment. A Critical or High blocks the merge: take the newest safe stable release instead (upgrade or downgrade), or record an R92 Projects risk the owner approves.

**Change.** An ordinary change (skill r92-assurance): reviewed by someone who is not the author, CI green, merged by a person, never automerged; production only through the change gate.
